description: The big events that fill a town -- festivals, carnivals, Christmas markets, races -- at the places TravelCharika lists, from this month on for a year: in one month, at one place, or all of them. Each with its dates as the site states them (confirmed by its own site; "expected" where they follow a rule its site has not yet confirmed; or when it usually falls), what it is, any closures its organiser names, its own site, and, given a departure city, how far it is from there in the site's words ("about 2h 05m by air from London"). A place under travel advice has none listed.

from_city.description: One of TravelCharika's departure cities, by its airport code ("DEL", "LON") or its name ("Delhi", "London", "Bombay"). Optional: how far each event is from there.

month.description: A month: 1 to 12, or its name ("December", "dec"). Optional: only that month's events.

place.description: A place TravelCharika covers: its id from search_places ("bali") or its name ("Bali", "Da Nang", "Ubud"). Optional: only that place's events.

name: events
title: Big events
